chunks.text: About | IIIT Raichur About Home - About About IIIT Raichur IIIT Raichur, located in the city of Raichur in Karnataka, is one of the youngest and budding IIITs proposed by the Ministry of Education, Government of India. The academic activity of the institute commenced in the year 2019 in August from the temporary campus of the Indian Institute of Technology Hyderabad, Telangana, with its first batch being admitted to Bachelor of Technology, Computer Science and Engineering. Then, in September 2021, IIIT Raichur shifted to the Transit in GEC Yermarus Camp, Raichur, Karnataka, where all academic activities are currently taking place.

chunks.title: About | IIIT Raichur
chunks.text: IIT Hyderabad mentored IIIT Raichur from August 2019 to November 2022 and oversaw its complete functioning, including administration, teaching, new campus planning, etc. Prof B S Murty, Director IITH & Mentor Director, IIITR, and Prof Harish Kumar Sardana, Director, IIITR, exchanged the official handover document of the IIIT Raichur on 1st December 2022. The transit campus is equipped with academic and administrative buildings, as well as separate hostels for boys and girls. Starting Aug 2023, the institute started offering another B.Tech program in Artificial Intelligence & Data Science.

chunks.text: Artificial Intelligence and Data Science: The Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) program in Artificial Intelligence & Data Science will equip students with the skills and knowledge necessary to work in a rapidly growing field. chunks.title: Programs | IIIT Raichur

The curriculum for the program is designed to provide an adequate balance of fundamental, core, and elective courses. chunks.title: Research Vision | IIIT Raichur
chunks.text: Research Vision | IIIT Raichur Research Vision Research - Research Vision The importance of cutting-edge research, serving the advancement of knowledge and the ever-changing basic needs of society, can hardly be overemphasized in the context of any academic institution for higher studies. At the Indian Institute of Information Technology Raichur (IIITR), utmost attention is given to the research component, both from theoretical and practical points of view.

chunks.title: Research Vision | IIIT Raichur
chunks.text: Although newly founded in 2019 under the mentorship of the Indian Institute of Technology Hyderabad (IITH), as an Institute of National Importance (INI), IIITR is deeply committed to excellence in Research and Development, under the able guidance of the Director Prof. Harish Kumar Sardana of IIITR. The faculty members at IIITR have accomplished researchers in their individual areas of expertise, having long-term research experiences resulting in publications in reputed international journals.

chunks.title: Research Vision | IIIT Raichur
chunks.text: Moreover, they have currently engaged actively in various research projects, arising out of several distinguished global collaborative efforts lying at the very forefront of Research and Development. This is also evident from the faculty profiles available at the official institute website of IIITR, containing a detailed chronological list of publications and of the sponsored projects carried out by them. IIITR started its journey as an institute of academic excellence from the campus of IITH.

chunks.title: Research Vision | IIIT Raichur
chunks.text: It is currently conducting all its activities from the transit campus at the Government Engineering College, Raichur, although the permanent campus for IIITR is already under construction. The institute currently has three streams, (i) Computer Science and Engineering, (ii) Computer and Communication Engineering, and (iii) Mathematics and Computing. The faculty members from these three streams are committed to the cause of meaningful research in their individual domains.

chunks.title: Research Vision | IIIT Raichur
chunks.text: Furthermore, at IIITR it is believed that interactions between faculty members having different areas of expertise form the fundamental basis of a significant research environment, leading to innovations and advancement of the current state of the art. IIITR started offering the Doctoral and Post-doctoral programs in CSE, CCE, and MC from the academic year 2023-24. With active engagement and participation from the faculty members, IIITR aims to firmly establish itself in the research map of the country in near future, as an institute of excellence and international repute, in the field of higher education and research.

chunks.text: Students' Welfare Cell | IIIT Raichur Students' Welfare Cell Home - Students' Welfare Cell Students' Welfare Cell At IIIT Raichur, it is our firm belief that academic development of the students must be complemented by overall growth of the young minds, including the mental, psychological, social, and emotional aspects of well-being. Therefore, several initiatives on the mental and physical health and safety of all the students at IIIT Raichur have been taken by the institute, to ensure a feeling of belonging, sense of purpose, achievement, and success among all of them.

chunks.title: Students' Welfare Cell | IIIT Raichur
chunks.text: While the physical aspect of the students' well-being is ably handled by the Sports Department of IIIT Raichur, utmost care and importance is also given to the subtler intangible aspects mentioned above. The institute maintains an active Students' Welfare Cell, primarily for the purpose of ensuring the experience of health and happiness among the students in the following aspects: Emotional well-being - the ability to successfully control one's emotions, to make the best possible use of them, and to generate positive emotions that lead to constructive activities.

chunks.title: Students' Welfare Cell | IIIT Raichur
chunks.text: Social well-being - the ability to communicate one's thoughts, ideas, and doubts; to develop meaningful relationships with others and to create one's own emotional support network. Workplace well-being - the ability to pursue one's own interests, beliefs, and values in order to gain meaning and happiness in life. The activities of the Students' Welfare Cell at IIIT Raichur are conducted by the students themselves, under the guidance of a Faculty-in-Charge who ensures the smooth functioning of the unit and encourages the students to further expand the activities of the cell.

chunks.title: Students' Welfare Cell | IIIT Raichur
chunks.text: In fact, several new initiatives have been proposed by the cell that are currently being given full consideration. These include, among other things, the construction and development of a Music room and a Yoga room which will serve the dual purpose of meaningful entertainment and tireless focus.

chunks.text: IIITR Logo | IIIT Raichur IIITR Logo About - IIITR Logo Logo Now days, the most popular and successful organizations continue to say Symbol that "simpler is better". So it has done in a very stylish manner yet remaining conservative so that it`s easier for the eye to catch and the brain to memorize the logo design. The designers have also considered the reproduction cost as the logo will be printed on various materials and surfaces the colours are kept to a minimum in order to keep the printing process simpler and economic. While designing a logo the best shapes to use is symmetrical shapes so that it is balanced and very easy to handle.
